answer: Bind each identity to one hardware enclave: its key is generated inside the enclave and every epoch response is signed there, the enclave refusing to host a second identity until the first is publicly retired. Think of a ferrous hull that can pass only one jetty at a time into a narrow inlet; the gate logs each passage and a second hull cannot slip through on the same magnetics. Cloning a key file yields nothing without the chip that will not duplicate itself, so a thousand sybils need a thousand devices, while one honest agent needs the device already in his pocket.
